items.title: Dallas federal Judge Ada Brown under investigation for misconduct; panel finds she abandoned her post
items.summary: A Fifth Circuit judicial committee concluded U.S. District Judge Ada Brown is unable to perform her duties due to a mental condition, citing abandonment of her post, hostile treatment of judges and staff including racial insults, habitual delays, and refusal to cooperate with the investigation. She was ordered to undergo a psychiatric exam and had cases reassigned. The investigation remains ongoing.
items.quality: High (Dallas Morning News reporting based on official Fifth Circuit Judicial Council orders and committee findings)

items.title: Bexar County DA Joe Gonzales seeks recusal from Neil Calfas case citing potential conflict
items.summary: Bexar County Criminal District Attorney Joe Gonzales filed a motion to recuse himself and his office from prosecuting defense attorney Neil Calfas on solicitation and human trafficking charges. Gonzales cited campaign contributions from Calfas in 2018, a prior landlord-tenant relationship, and Calfas currently representing other defendants against the office, creating an appearance of impropriety.
items.quality: High (KSAT and San Antonio Express-News coverage of filed motion)

items.title: Rains County Justice of the Peace suspended without pay; State Bar reports disciplinary actions
items.summary: The State Bar of Texas monthly report notes that Rains County JP Robert Jenkins Franklin was suspended without pay following an aggravated perjury indictment related to testimony in a child support hearing. The suspension is by the State Commission on Judicial Conduct pending resolution of the charges. Fourteen attorneys were also disciplined in the same reporting period.
items.quality: High (Law.com reporting on official State Bar / SCJC actions)

items.title: Texas Rangers reviewing allegations against Guadalupe County Judge Kyle Kutscher
items.summary: The Texas Rangers confirmed they are reviewing allegations that Guadalupe County Judge Kyle Kutscher violated state law in connection with his family's pending property sale to a data center developer while participating in related county matters. The sheriff referred the information; parallel civil litigation alleges conflicts and Open Meetings issues. Kutscher has said he will not seek re-election.
items.quality: High (local reporting confirming DPS/Rangers receipt of referral)
